summary: This is a gitignore file pattern that tells Git to ignore the `.git` directory and everything inside it everywhere in the repository. The `**` means 'at any nesting level' and `/.git` means 'the .git folder', so this prevents Git from trying to track its own internal folder.

explanations.1: The `**/` prefix means 'match this pattern at any directory depth', and `/.git` matches the hidden `.git` folder that Git creates to store version history and configuration — we tell Git to ignore it so it doesn't try to recursively track itself.
